name: Cue on the downbeat
lesson:
## Set it on the one, recall it on the one

CUE on the first downbeat, then set hot cues A1, A2 and A3 on the downbeats of bars 5, 9 and 13. From bar 17 recall them one per bar: A1, A2, A3, A1. Setting and recalling are the same skill; a cue placed 30 ms late is 30 ms late every time you press it for the rest of your career.

Set cues while the track is playing rather than paused: the press has to be in time, and in time means on the kick, not on the flash of the waveform. If a recall sounds like a flam against the beat, the cue itself is off; delete and reset rather than compensating with your hand.

tracks.cue: Drum-machine intro: cue on the first kick, set A1 to A3 on bars 5, 9 and 13, then recall them from bar 17 and listen for the kick doubling if you are late.
The chopped vocal fragments in the intro land on downbeats: a cue set 30 ms late doubles the fragment every time you recall it.
Cue on the first kick under the filtered guitar loop; the loop's phrase starts tell you whether each recall is on the one.
